'''Dunclair Gostegion''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] hailing from the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Dissatisfied with the prospect of a corporate job, he joined [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]] as a teenager. Gostegion's father attempted to straighten him out by enrolling him in a strict boarding school; the young man stowed away on a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and left his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] behind. Drifting throughout the Corporate Sector and [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], Gostegion became known as both a [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] and a [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslinger]], even traveling with [[Gallandro/Legends|Gallandro]] for a time.<ref name="J15" />

Gostegion's travels take him to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], where he engaged in a game of high-stakes [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with two young card sharks and the [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]]. During the game, Gostegion caught one of the young men cheating, and called him out. The cheater drew his gun and the gunslinger responded in kind, killing the young man. However, Gostegion found out that the dead card player was the son of one of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun's]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigos]]. Unsure of how the Vigo would react to the death of his son, Gostegion fled to [[Tasariq]] to keep a low profile.<ref name="J15" />
